newsitem.title: TURKEY: Raks Elektronik sees higher '97 sales.
newsitem.headline: Raks Elektronik sees higher '97 sales.

text.p: Turkey's unique magnetic and optic media producer Raks Elektronik Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S. aims to increase its total sales by 19.7 percent to $174 million this year from $145.3 million in 1996, a senior official said.
Oguz Dagli, board member of Raks Holding, said about 80 percent of total sales would consist of exports.
"We aim to increase exports to $135 million this year from last year's $117 million," Dagli told Reuters.
Shares of the company opened at 39,000 lira on Monday and closed the first session at 40,500 lira on the Istanbul Stock Exchange.
